coverage.note: Since C02 every uppercase glyph is an authored-contour master; none is provisional. The fixture contract still carries pre-C02 coverage labels; they are recorded here unchanged, next to the current maturity.
coverage.ownerDesignReview: pending for all glyphs (docs/reports/proof/T06/review/ratings.json has no records)

engineVersions.glyphLibrary: legacy-v06-import/1.0.0; nightshift.authored.c02-wave1@1.0.0; nightshift.authored.c02-wave2@1.0.0; nightshift.authored.c02-wave3@1.0.0; nightshift.authored.c02-wave4@1.0.0; nightshift.semantic-overlay.abgrs@1.5.0

limitations: Only the C03 resolver subset is compared: Neutral, Straight, Bubble, Blockbuster. Parameters are uncalibrated grammar defaults.
Wildstyle is requested only to record that interlocking is skipped (C04 missing); it is not drawn.
Pairs and words use a fixed gap (Bubble: bounce placement). No joins, overlaps by design or relationship solving.
The Creator graffiti engine (src/style/graffiti-engine.js, D-017) builds letters from separate skeletons, not from these masters; it is outside this brief and not on these plates.
Rendering treatments (outline, depth, highlights) are not shown; finish isolation is checked by the tests, not on a plate.

renderProfile.scale: one uniform scale per plate for all styles (native glyph units, not normalised per glyph)

review.note: Plates are evidence, not approval. Reviews here concern derived, reference-only style geometry and never change the maturity of a master. The current review schema offers pass / fail / needs-revision only; there is no tie / neither / cannot-judge option.
